mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT over the last two weeks signals fewer weekday trips and weaker downtown circulation, which will keep RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not remain below its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay at or below current levels.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises above 20 points from baseline, people substitute away from outside shopping trips and concentrate spending at home, pushing RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL is above 20 for a weekly mean, despite no rebound in mobility to outside venues.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES amplifies access frictions and suppresses discretionary shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC will weaken further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four-week mean even though both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain depressed or decline further.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stabilizes while PARKS rebounds from its trough, household errand chains and neighborhood circulation improve, lifting retail visits with a one-week lag.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from the prior week after a two-week decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after PARKS rebounds and GROCERY_PHARM stops falling.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PARKS activity after a weak outdoor season reflects better weather and more foot traffic in public spaces, which spills into nearby retail and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean even after PARKS stays above its recent low for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT falls below minus 60 percent, the city is in a low-access regime where retail trips lose momentum and RETAIL_REC keeps deteriorating over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after TRANSIT is below -60 on a weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are both depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, commuting-based shopping trips are replaced by stay-at-home behavior, keeping RETAIL_REC lower than the prior month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining depressed and RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps falling while RETAIL_REC is already weak, the same household caution suppresses discretionary outings and retail demand will stay below the previous four-week level.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM declines for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds within 7 days after two straight weekly declines in GROCERY_PHARM.
